scenes.title: Files in this change
scenes.narration: Today every part of the server reads its own settings from the environment, and a missing one shows up much later as a strange error. This change reads all the settings once, in one new folder.

notes.src/config/schema.ts: every setting, its type and default

steps.say: The new config folder lists every setting the server needs, and checks them all when the server starts.
The old helper, which read one setting at a time, is deleted.
The server, the database pool and the mailer now read their settings from the one checked object.
The example settings file moves into the config folder, and lists the pool size too.
A new test checks the defaults, and that a missing setting is named.

scenes.narration: The schema is the one list of settings.

steps.say: The port is a number with a default, so the server starts without it.
The database address has no default. Without it the server refuses to start, and says which setting is missing.
The pool size is a number too, ten unless set.
The mail settings must be there, and the sender must look like an email address.

scenes.narration: The server shows the swap every other file makes.

steps.say: It imports the config object instead of the old helper.
The port and the database address come from that object, already checked and already numbers.
